question: What new fillet option did SOLIDWORKS 2027 add?
answer:
Based on SOLIDWORKS 2027 help documentation [3], the sources I have don't say what new fillet option 2027 added.

The "What's New for SOLIDWORKS Products 2027" page excerpt only gives a general welcome and says the document covers all 2027 enhancements, with no fillet details [3]. The other 2027 pages describe existing fillet workflows, not new ones. One tutorial says to click Fillet on the Features tab and select items under Items to Fillet [6]. A selection page says you can right-click an edge in a loop and choose Select Loop for operations such as feature fillet and chamfer [1]. None of these is marked as new in 2027.

To answer this, I would need the Fillets section of the 2027 What's New document. If you'd like, you can paste that section here.
